mapper.select: SELECT vc.id, vc.video_id AS videoId, vc.user_id AS userId, vc.parent_id AS parentId, vc.root_id AS rootId, vc.content, vc.created_at AS createdAt, u.username, u.nickname, -- COALESCE(字段,默认值)：如果子查询没有统计到回复数，返回0，避免null赋值给VO COALESCE(reply_count.replyCount, 0) AS replyCount FROM video_comment vc INNER JOIN sys_user u ON vc.user_id = u.id -- 左连接一个子查询结果集，用来统计每条一级评论下面有多少条子回复 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT root_id, COUNT(1) AS replyCount FROM video_comment WHERE status = 1 AND video_id = #{videoId} AND parent_id <> 0 GROUP BY root_id ) reply_count ON reply_count.root_id = vc.id WHERE vc.video_id = #{videoId} AND vc.parent_id = 0 AND vc.status = 1 ORDER BY vc.created_at DESC, vc.id DESC

SELECT vc.id, vc.video_id AS videoId, vc.user_id AS userId, vc.parent_id AS parentId, vc.root_id AS rootId, vc.content, vc.created_at AS createdAt, u.username, u.nickname, parent.user_id AS replyToUserId, parent_user.username AS replyToUsername, parent_user.nickname AS replyToNickname FROM video_comment vc INNER JOIN sys_user u ON vc.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN video_comment parent ON parent.id = vc.parent_id INNER JOIN sys_user parent_user ON parent_user.id = parent.user_id WHERE vc.video_id = #{videoId} AND vc.root_id = #{parentId} AND vc.status = 1 ORDER BY vc.created_at ASC, vc.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE video_comment SET status = 0, deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{commentId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
UPDATE video_comment SET status = 0, deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{commentId} AND status = 1
UPDATE video_comment SET status = 0, deleted_at = NOW(), cascade_deleted_root_id = #{rootId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE root_id = #{rootId} AND status = 1
UPDATE video_comment SET status = 1, deleted_at = NULL, cascade_deleted_root_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE root_id = #{rootId} AND cascade_deleted_root_id = #{rootId} AND status = 0
UPDATE video_comment SET status = 1, deleted_at = NULL, cascade_deleted_root_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{commentId} AND status = 0
